items.text: Čo potrebujeme na oslavu? = What do we need for the party?
items.picture: In the dorm kitchen, Emma, Lucia and Tomáš plan Lucia's birthday party: Emma sits at the table writing a shopping list, Tomáš leans over her shoulder, and Lucia checks what's in the open fridge.

items.text: chlieb a maslo = bread and butter
items.picture: A fresh round loaf on a wooden board next to a dish of butter; a knife spreads butter on a thick slice.

items.text: syr a šunka = cheese and ham
items.picture: Emma makes little open sandwiches for the party, laying slices of ham and cheese on bread; Lucia steals one.

items.text: víno, pivo a džús = wine, beer and juice
items.picture: The drinks for the party lined up on the dorm kitchen counter: a bottle of red wine, a few bottles of beer and a big jug of orange juice, with glasses.

items.text: káva a minerálka = coffee and mineral water
items.picture: At a table in the café near the university, Tomáš has a cup of coffee and a glass of sparkling mineral water next to his laptop.

items.text: Koľko stojí šunka? = How much is the ham?
items.picture: In the corner shop, Emma points at a ham in the deli counter and asks the price; the shop assistant lifts it onto the scales.

items.text: Kúpim čerstvý chlieb. = I'll buy fresh bread.
items.picture: In the neighbourhood bakery, the baker hands Emma a warm loaf straight from the oven; she closes her eyes to smell it.

items.text: červený, modrý, zelený = red, blue, green
items.picture: A washing line on the dormitory balcony with three T-shirts drying in the sun: a red one, a blue one and a green one.

items.text: biely, čierny, žltý = white, black, yellow
items.picture: The same washing line, now with a white T-shirt, a black one and a yellow one; Lucia pegs up the last.

items.text: tričko a sveter = T-shirt and sweater
items.picture: In a clothes shop, Emma holds up a T-shirt in one hand and a chunky knitted sweater in the other, trying to decide.

items.text: sukňa a košeľa = skirt and shirt
items.picture: At the clothes shop mirror, Emma holds a skirt against herself; behind her, Tomáš buttons up a checked shirt and pulls a face.

items.text: Chcem čierne tričko. = I want a black T-shirt.
items.picture: At the clothes shop counter, Tomáš points at a black T-shirt on a high shelf; a young salesman reaches up for it.

items.text: darček = present, gift
items.picture: Emma and Tomáš come out of a shop carrying a present for Lucia, wrapped in bright paper with a big bow, looking pleased with themselves.

items.text: Akú farbu máš rada? = What colour do you like? (to a woman)
items.picture: In the clothes shop, Tomáš holds up two scarves, a green one and a blue one, and asks Emma which colour she likes; she points at the green one.

items.text: Lucia má dnes narodeniny. = It's Lucia's birthday today.
items.picture: Morning in the dorm room: Lucia wakes up to balloons tied to her bed; Emma stands beside it holding a small birthday cake with lit candles.

items.text: Všetko najlepšie! = Happy birthday! / All the best!
items.picture: Lucia's birthday party in the dorm kitchen, balloons everywhere: Emma hugs Lucia and holds out the present; Tomáš and Marek clap behind them.

items.text: It's your friend's birthday. What do you say?
torta a sviečky = cake and candles
items.picture: The lights are off at Lucia's party: Marek carries in a big chocolate cake he baked himself, its candles lighting up everyone's faces.

items.text: kytica = bouquet (of flowers)
items.picture: At the door of the dorm kitchen, Tomáš, a little shy, holds out a big bouquet of flowers to Lucia.

items.text: Veľa zdravia, šťastia a lásky! = Lots of health, happiness and love!
items.picture: Pán Kováč drops in on the party with a little potted plant and shakes Lucia's hand warmly, wishing her well.

items.text: Ďakujem za darček. = Thanks for the present.
items.picture: Lucia tears the bright paper off Emma and Tomáš's present, a cosy knitted sweater, and hugs it, delighted.

items.text: Kedy prídeš? — O hodinu. = When are you coming? — In an hour.
items.picture: Split picture of a phone call. Left: Emma, shopping in a drugstore with a trolley, holds her phone to her ear. Right: Lucia, in the dorm kitchen among half-laid party things, asks her when she'll be back.

items.text: Na zdravie! Marek raises his glass. What does he mean?
items.picture: At Lucia's party, Marek raises his glass in a toast; Emma, Lucia and Tomáš lift theirs to clink.
